spec_case: issue #602/#726 (http's save_to: within, overwrite, max_bytes, and a non-2xx status)
description: `save_to` writes the body to a file within `within` (value: {path, bytes, sha256, content_type, status}); a second download to the same path without `overwrite` fails before any request and leaves the first file untouched; `overwrite: true` replaces it with the new body; `max_bytes` below the body's size fails and leaves no file; a 404 writes nothing and the effect's own value has a null path. The last effect removes the scratch directory it all wrote under.
